name: Fire Wall of the Nexus
text: Each time a "Nexus" monster card is sent to the GY place 1 "Nexus" counter on this card. Once per turn: During your main phase you can remove up to 1 "Nexus" Counter from this card then Special Summon a Cyberse monster from your GY. "Nexus" Monsters you control gain 300 ATK.
